ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Fabrication Methods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the United Front Fabricator workbench needed to produce United Front equipment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft armor and helmets that provide stronger protection than flak gear and cover more of the body.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carapace Molecular Plating
ResearchProjectDef.description: Apply molecular-grade plating techniques to Carapace armor, producing heavier configurations with substantially improved protection at increased material cost.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carapace Refined Compositions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine Carapace composite formulations for specialized officer-grade armor configurations that combine protection with the appearance expected of command personnel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Woven Uniforms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor garments that provide light protection and insulation for a variety of climates.

ResearchProjectDef.label: High-Frequency Generators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct weapons that use ultrasonic vibration generators. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Reinforced Vibrostructures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct vibro-weapons of greater size and intensity with reinforced structures to handle the power. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ion-Charge Munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt the faction's storm-weapon superstructures to the charged-shot principle, fabricating pulse-charged firearms that fire high-energy slugs wrapped in an ionized charge. The charge occasionally discharges an electromagnetic pulse on impact that disrupts shields and mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Heavy Ion-Charge Munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scale ion-charge munitions up to squad-support calibers: the heavy charge rifle, the suppressive charge cannon, and the anti-materiel charge lance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Standard Pattern Arms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the standard pattern firearms carried by United Front infantry.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Thermal Dispersion Fields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a shield belt that blocks heat and flame in addition to projectiles. Holds less charge than a standard belt but recharges far faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Sabot Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt the fabricator to electrothermal-chemical small arms: a plasma cartridge drives a discarding-sabot penetrator down the barrel at high velocity, trading rate of fire for armor penetration. Enables the sabot pistol and sabot rifle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Heavy Sabot Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scale the sabot pattern up to heavy and specialist calibers: larger rods, larger charges, and reinforced barrels. Enables the heavy sabot rifle, the sabot sniper rifle, the sabot autocannon, and the flechette shotgun.
